acceptance.given: Frozen historical records exist with established membership, paths, and byte contents.

oracle.expected: A before/after comparison reports identical frozen historical membership, paths, and byte digests.
forbidden: Any addition, removal, relocation, renaming, or byte modification of frozen historical records.
oracle.observable: The historical-record comparison artifact reports equality across membership, paths, and bytes.

acceptance.then: Frozen historical membership, paths, and bytes remain identical.
acceptance.when: During repair or runtime-evidence handling, run the repository historical-record comparison in the unit lane.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Alter membership, path, or bytes of a frozen historical record and run the comparison; validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compare frozen historical membership, paths, and bytes before and after evidence handling, rejecting any drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing history formats and append-only semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Historical baseline -> evidence handling -> membership/path/byte comparison.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Comparison reports equality; any difference produces failure.

acceptance.given: The supported Acceptance package route set is exposed or changed.

oracle.expected: Route discovery and accessibility checks find every supported Acceptance package route present and accessible.
forbidden: Supported Acceptance package routes are unavailable or removed.
oracle.observable: The Toolchain route validation returns the complete supported Acceptance route set with successful access checks.

acceptance.then: Supported Acceptance package routes remain present and accessible.
acceptance.when: Run route availability validation against current Toolchain route definitions and callers.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Disable one supported Acceptance package route and run route validation; it fails identifying the missing route.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Keep supported Acceptance package routes exposed and validate their accessibility.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing route names and interfaces.

slice_hint.state_transition: Route definitions -> discovery/access checks -> available or missing-route verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every supported Acceptance route is discovered and accessible.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded but independent dependency verification has not yet been established.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains an independently produced dependency-verification record bound to the replay identity.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent dependency verification.
oracle.observable: Replay evidence inspection finds a dependency-verification artifact produced independently of the replay success signal.

acceptance.then: Dependencies are independently verified and recorded for the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: After replay success, run the independent dependency verifier and inspect its evidence in the integration lane.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a successful Replay Result lacking an independent dependency-verification record; evidence validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay evidence to include an independently generated, identity-bound dependency-verification record.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep replay result schema backward compatible; dependency evidence is additive.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay success -> independent dependency verification -> verified evidence or failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success is accepted only when independent identity-bound dependency evidence exists.

acceptance.given: An aggregate execution is running under configured time and output budgets.

oracle.expected: The aggregate records one deterministic terminal state, with budget exhaustion classified unsuccessful.
forbidden: The aggregate ends in an indeterminate or nondeterministic terminal state.
oracle.observable: Repeated aggregate evaluations with identical inputs and budgets produce the same terminal classification.

acceptance.then: The aggregate reaches and records a deterministically identified terminal state.
acceptance.when: Execute the aggregate evaluator repeatedly with identical inputs and budgets, then compare terminal-state records in the runtime lane.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run identical aggregate inputs repeatedly and detect differing or missing terminal classifications; the deterministic-terminal check fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bound aggregate time/output and emit a stable terminal classification, marking budget exhaustion unsuccessful.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve evaluator result fields and existing terminal-state compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate starts -> bounded evaluation -> deterministic terminal record.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each run records exactly one terminal classification before limits; identical reruns agree.
